entry.title: Add a Slider Image Banner
entry.content:
Description

In addition to video elements, an image slider offers a visually engaging way to present multiple images in a slick carousel format. This component is perfect for highlighting key features, showcasing portfolios, or creating a visually rich storytelling experience. This feature is for Nextgen-v2.

Adding a Video Header component.

  1. In the WPBakery editor of your page
  2. Click the ‘+’ icon in the top right corner
  3. Use the text search to find ‘Header Video & Image’
  4. The Video Header Settings box will open out
  5. From here Select Header type Slider from the dropdown
  6. Click on the option to add a new slide. This will open the settings where you can upload images.
  7. Click Save and the component will be added to the page

Pro Tip

Ensure that your images are optimized for web performance to maintain fast loading times.

Use high-quality visuals that align with your brand identity for a professional and engaging appearance.

If using multiple slides, keep the content concise and visually appealing to maintain visitor interest.

Regularly update your slider content to keep your website fresh and engaging.

entry.title: Cookies Policy Template (English & Vietnamese)
entry.content:
Description

We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience and improve our website. Cookies are small files stored on your device that help us collect technical data, such as your IP address, browser type, and site interactions. By using our site, you agree to our use of cookies.

Assign template to the admin page

Create a new page and assign the VN ENG Privacy Policies Page template to it.

Privacy Global Option

  1. Added a global option for the school name.
  2. Dynamically added the school prefix.
  3. Integrated the school email using the global option.
  4. Included a field for the School Data Protection Coordinator. I have created a global theme option and added fields for the school name, school prefix, school email, and School Data Protection Coordinator.

Pro Tip

Regularly review and update your cookie policy to stay compliant with privacy regulations like GDPR and CCPA. Additionally, consider implementing a cookie consent banner to give users control over their preferences.

entry.title: Add Global Blog Articles
entry.content:
Description

Blogs are great for driving traffic to your website. Prospective parents and guardians can be inspired to read a blog via an internet search on a subject, or after seeing an interesting post on social media. Ensure that the format of your blogs will continue to engage the user to read on! Use this details component to create the ideal layout for the blogs on your website so that you can include section headers and suitable illustrative images. Adding a blog post is also a custom post type like Blog but it has more flexibility to modify the post page in the same way as a site page. To access the posts area navigate to the admin area (wp-admin) and find the menu item ‘Posts’.

Adding a new Blog Post

  1. Click Add New Blog Post
  2. Give you post a title
  3. Add Post description under the content editor section.
  4. Add a the primary image in the Featured Image section
  5. Add Blog Catgeories.
  6. Save your post as a draft or publish button

Assign template to the admin page

Create a new page and assign the global blog template to it.

Change header banner title and background

  1. Go to Visual Composer Content > All Items
  2. Select Header of Blog element
  3. Click on the title that is selected for the archive header banner
  4. Then edit custom heading component
  5. Then change the text for header banner title

Differnce between Posts and Custom post type Blog

  1. Posts are Built-in content type in WordPress.
  2. Primarily used for blog posts, news, and other time-sensitive content.
  3. Organized using categories and tags (taxonomy).
  4. Appears in the main blog feed.
  5. Can be displayed in reverse chronological order.

  6. Supports features like author, comments, and RSS feeds by default.

  7. Custom Post Type Blog
  8. A user-defined content type that extends the default post functionality.
  9. Useful for creating structured content like portfolios, testimonials, products, events, FAQs, etc.
  10. Can have custom taxonomies (e.g., a “Genre” taxonomy for a “Movies” CPT).
  11. Does not appear in the default blog feed unless explicitly added.
  12. Custom templates and metaboxes can be assigned for different layouts.

Adding a Sidebar

  1. Click Appearance > Widgets.
  2. Drag NextGen Global Blog to the sidebar.
  3. Add a Sidebar Title.
  4. Specify the Number of Posts to Show.
  5. Select Order By and Order options.
  6. Check the checkbox to Show Featured Image, or leave it unchecked if you don’t want to display it.
  7. Check the checkbox to Display Categories.
  8. Check the checkbox to Display Date.
  9. Click the Save button.

Pro Tip

Simple tips for laying out text in a blog to improve readability: include compelling headlines, helpful subheadings & bullet points to summarise or overview a subject.

entry.title: Add a Video Testimonial slider
entry.content:
Description

Adding a Video Slider post is a custom post type, similar to a Video Slider, but it offers more flexibility to modify the post page in the same way as a site page. To access the posts area, navigate to the admin area (wp-admin) and find the “Video Sliders” menu item.

Adding a new Video Slider

  1. Click “Add New Video Slider.”
  2. Give your post a title.
  3. Below the content section, under the “Video Slider Section,” add the YouTube video URL in the video field.
  4. You can either add a new video category or select an existing one.
  5. Save your post by clicking the “Publish” button.

WP Bakery side changes

  1. Open the WPBakery Frontend Editor on the page you want to modify.
  2. Select the Video Sliders component in WPBakery.
  3. Choose a taxonomy and click the “Save Changes” button.
  4. Click the “Update” button to save your changes.

Pro Tip

You can directly add YouTube and Vimeo video URLs to the video slider.

entry.title: Add About the Author box at the bottom of our blog pages

link.title: Add About the Author box at the bottom of our blog pages

entry.content:
Description

The Blog Author box provides details about the individual responsible for creating and contributing to the blog. It typically showcases the author’s name and may include their image as well, offering readers a glimpse into the person behind the content they’re engaging with.

Adding authors in admin dashboard

  1. Go to admin dashboard
  2. Under the section ‘Posts’ click on author
  3. You can add your author name,description and image
  4. Click on save button

Adding author for Blog Post

  1. Click edit post
  2. Under the section ‘Author’ select the author for post
  3. After you have made your changes you will need to publish the post

entry.title: Event Registration In Dynamics CRM Marketing.

link.title: Event Registration In Dynamics CRM Marketing.

entry.content:
Note : This option will be available after 13th APRIL 2024 !

Description

This functionality is useful for generating new events upon form submission in the Dynamics CRM portal.

Enable and Manage Events

  • For the initial implementation, consider requesting the addition of an events form on the website by submitting a ticket to the website developers. We can either create a new form or use an existing one (long or short) to select events.

or Long form / Short Form with Single campus only like Asian Inquiry Websites.

Created And Add Events In Event Data

  • Once Events are enabled, school admin can login to the CMS/website and navigate to the CRM Multi Events menu in the menu bar on the left.
  • Click on “Add Row” to create events in the Event From and update.
  • If this is a new setup to add events then click on the plus icon to open the accordion.
  • Enter a valid event name. It is not necessary to use any comma (,), ‘s, & in this field.
  • Select the event campus, for which option you need to add the event.
  • There is no need to add or edit the “Main events shown” field. Since this is just to show where the event created will appear on the form side.
  • Add event start date, start time, end date, end time to the event. Note*: End time should be greater than start time.
  • To add another event, click the “Add Row” or + icon in the right side button and follow the same steps.
  • Save/Update the event with “Update” button on right top side of the page.

Link Pre-Created Event

  • In “Event Name” enter the same event name as created/exists in CRM Marketing side.
  • Fill in all the event details and save the changes.

Verify Events On Form

  • Open the Front End Side form and select the campus for which the events were added from the CMS side.
  • On selecting an option there will be a dropdown and we can verify the event name in the option. like in below screenshot for multicampus school:
  • Like for single campus school any form event has been setup like in below screenshot :

Then on user side it will apear like in below screenshot :

See The registered users in CRM.

  • After successful form submission we can see the record in CRM Marketing Events section

&

Pro Tip

Prior to scheduling any events, it’s essential to obtain approval and thoroughly test the form design for CRM entries with PO & website developers. When linking pre-created events, ensure that the event name matches the events in the CRM marketing side for the relevant event.

entry.title: How To Change Category Tag Colour

link.title: How To Change Category Tag Colour

entry.content:
Description

We can enable category wise tag color and change Category Tag Colour in edit category page

Enable category wise tag color

  1. Go to Next-Gen Options > Blog
  2. Then select the Enable Category Tagging colour checkbox

Change Category Tag Colour

  1. Go to Posts > Categories
  2. Then edit category where you want to change the color
  3. Then select category tagging colour

entry.title: How To Change Archive Pages Header Banner

link.title: How To Change Archive Pages Header Banner

entry.content:
Description

The Header Banner will be displayed at the top of the Archive Pages. It will include a title,background image and background colour

Select template for Archive header banner

  1. Go to Next-Gen Options > Header
  2. Scroll down the page
  3. Then select Choose a template for header banner on Archive Pages

Change header banner title and background

  1. Go to Visual Composer Content > All Items
  2. Click on the title that is selected for the archive header banner
  3. Then edit custom heading component
  4. Then change the text for header banner title
